title: Artin--Schreier model of characteristic-p degree-one pullback
statement: Let f:C→Spec(k) be a smooth proper connected curve of dimension at most one [def-sc-curves, def-weil-proper-morphism], k⊆k′ algebraically closed fields of characteristic p>0, and C′ its base change. For every commutative coefficient ring Λ, the H¹ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] pullback for the constant sheaf Λ/(p) admits compatible additive equivalences with I→₀V^F and I→₀(k′⊗_kV)^{F′}, where V is a finite-dimensional k-vector space, F is p-semilinear, F′ is its tensor extension, and pullback in every coordinate is v↦1⊗v. This is a model and compatibility assertion, without asserting that the map of fixed points is bijective.

source.place: proof, Artin--Schreier kernels and flat coherent base change; Tags 02KH, 03Q5, 0739 for flat base change and coefficient colimits

proof.text: Establish qcqs hypotheses on C using its curve structure and on C' using stability of properness under the supplied pullback. Apply the prime-coefficient Frobenius model to obtain V,F,F' and compatible equivalences e,e'.
Apply the arbitrary-coefficient Finsupp pullback comparison in degree one, obtaining one index I and compatible coordinate equivalences a,b.

Compose a with Finsupp.mapRange.addEquiv e and b with Finsupp.mapRange.addEquiv e'. Evaluate each coordinate, rewrite by the coefficient naturality equation, and apply prime-coefficient compatibility. This is the complete Lean proof of the original unchanged statement.
